name: aipe-magnetics-database
description: Magnetic data expert: standardised material, core-geometry and measurement data with provenance and licences, served read-only by the aipe-magnetics-database Python package through its local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Magnetic material and measurement data with provenance
interface.longDescription: Read-only access to standardised magnetic data (schema v0.2, SI units): canonical materials deduplicated across sources, core shapes and parts, measured core-loss tables, complex permeability, B-H curves, with source, licence and data class for every record. Requires the aipe-magnetics-database Python package (pip install 'aipe-magnetics-database[mcp]').
